# POST /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs/{run}/rerun-failed-jobs

Reruns all failed or cancelled jobs in a workflow run

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-288`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| run | path | integer | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`

## Response

**201** — empty

- **400** — Run not done or invalid argument
- **403** — Permission denied
- **404** — Run not found
- **409** — Attempt already exists
- **422** — Validation failed

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |

| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | getCurrentRepoActionRunJobsByID | controller | Get run; Get latest attempt jobs |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | actions_service.GetFailedJobsForRerun | service | Filter jobs with status Failure or Cancelled |
| 3 | [services](../modules/services.md) | actions_service.RerunWorkflowRunJobs | service | Same as ep-287 step 2 but with filtered jobs + downstream expansion |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| Run must belong to the specified repository | validation | run.id = runID AND run.repo_id = repoID |
| Run must be in a done state before rerun is allowed | validation | !run.Status.IsDone() |
| Workflow must not be disabled for rerun | validation | cfg.IsWorkflowDisabled(run.WorkflowID) |
| Maximum rerun attempts cap (default 50) | validation | latestAttempt.Attempt >= setting.Actions.MaxRerunAttempts |
| Rerun failed jobs filters to only Failure or Cancelled status | business_logic | job.Status == StatusFailure || job.Status == StatusCancelled |
| Rerun expands to include all downstream dependent jobs | business_logic | A job's Needs contains a job in the rerun set |
| Legacy runs (LatestAttemptID=0) get backfilled with attempt=1 before rerun | business_logic | run.LatestAttemptID == 0 |

### Error Paths

- **Run not done** → handleWorkflowRerunError → 400
- **Attempt already exists** → handleWorkflowRerunError → 409
